description: Poly Clone: copies each channel of a polyphonic input a chosen number of times and merges every copy into one polyphonic output

params.text: Sets how many copies are made of each input channel, from 1 to 16
Sets the channel order at the output: yellow keeps all the copies of one input channel together, blue lays out the input channels as a set and repeats the whole set

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are copied; unpatched it counts as one channel of 0V. A lamp glows yellow for each channel whose copies fit within 16 and red for each that does not

outputs.text: Every copy of every input channel merged into one polyphonic cable, in the order the GRP button sets

menu: Add Auxilliary Clone expander — places one immediately to the right, giving four more polyphonic input and output pairs copied by the same count
